seeded.note: Seeded 2026-11-03 from official documents opened in this session. On San Francisco ballots: the San Francisco Department of Elections' Voter Information Pamphlet for the November 3, 2026 Consolidated General Election (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/N26_EN_VIP.pdf, src:media-api-sf-gov-e4221ecde7) lists "BART Director, District 8*" under "District Offices" (p. 4), with the footnote "*Voters residing in BART District 7 or District 9 will not have this contest on their ballot because they will elect their representatives in the November 2028 Election."; its ballot worksheet lists "BART Director, District 8*" under "DISTRICT (Vote for One)" (p. 247). Candidate: the Department of Elections' page Candidates - November 3, 2026, General Election (https://www.sf.gov/candidates-november-3-2026-general-election, src:sf-gov-6871cf14b5) lists one name under "BART Board, District 8" ("1 person has qualified for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot."): Sara Barz. The Department's Board of Supervisors and Other Local Offices Chinese-character-based Names and Ballot Designations List (https://api.sf.gov/documents/63094/November_2026_Local_Office_Names_and_Ballot_Designations.pdf, src:api-sf-gov-cd997081d7) prints SARA BARZ with the ballot designation "Transportation Planning Manager" under "BART Director, District 8"; the candidate's statement is on p. 37 of the pamphlet. The Candidates page also lists "Write-In Candidates" with "0 people have filed for candidacy for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot." No office record for a BART Director exists in data/offices, so office_ref is not set. No stance questions are set yet.
